value.rationale: At the precise null-recurrent boundary of the source dynamical family the induced-step return tail is polynomial, but accumulated original-time excursions exhibit a sharp logarithmic law. This captures a natural physical-clock recurrence invariant, determines its exact golden-ratio coefficient and proves divergence of every positive moment. The result is stronger and mathematically different from drift-based recurrence classification or generic finite enumeration.
